source_name: ČNB – Seznamy a evidence (hub for all supervisory lists and registers)
why_relevant: Master index page of every list/register the ČNB is legally obliged to publish (JERRS, prospectus registers, other lists, open data, WS JERRS). Single crawl entry point that snowballs into all register-type sources for CZ banking and payments.

source_name: ČNB — Czech and selected foreign associations working on financial market (directory)
why_relevant: The supervisor's own curated list of the financial-market associations it recognises, with their URLs (ČBA, ADZ credit unions, ČAP, AKAT, ČASF, APS ČR pension funds, actuaries, brokers). Authoritative way to bound the association universe for this cell and to catch bodies the seed queries missed. A cs mirror exists under /cs/.

source_name: ČNB – Informační povinnosti dohlížených subjektů (disclosure duties, incl. link registers)
why_relevant: Sets out what supervised entities must themselves publish, and maintains registers of links to the institutions' own mandatory-disclosure pages. Doubles as a pointer that snowballs into a full actor list of CZ banks/credit unions with their disclosure endpoints — a bridge from the ČNB cell into entity-level sources.

source_name: ČNB – Přehled odkazů na webové stránky bank obsahující povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: The single best entry point for this cell: the supervisor's own maintained index of every CZ bank's mandatory-disclosure page (per zákon č. 21/1992 Sb. and CRR Part Eight). Snowballing this yields the authoritative, complete actor list of regulated-entity publishers with their disclosure URLs.

source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (NKOD) – ČNB datasets
why_relevant: The national open-data catalogue carries ČNB dataset records with DCAT metadata (distribution URLs, update frequency 'daily', contact seznamy.subjektu@cnb.cz). Useful for discovering ČNB datasets we did not know existed and for machine-readable freshness metadata.

source_name: zakony.gov.cz — e-Sbírka/e-Legislativa open data & public API announcement page
why_relevant: Official pointer describing that e-Sbírka exposes open data and public APIs (live since 15 Jan 2024) — the entry point for machine-readable ingestion of the CZ legal corpus rather than HTML scraping.

source_name: FAÚ — Právní předpisy (legal acts index for AML/sanctions)
why_relevant: Curated list of the applicable legal base (AMLZ 253/2008 Sb., sanction acts 69/2006 Sb. and 1/2023 Sb., EU regulations). Serves as the authoritative mapping from 'obligation' to 'statutory provision', which anchors deadline and obligation extraction.

source_name: Vláda ČR — Legislativní pravidla vlády / metodika zpracování materiálů
why_relevant: Defines the mandatory structure of a Czech bill package (návrh zákona, důvodová zpráva, RIA, srovnávací tabulky, seznam připomínkových míst) and the standard comment period. Essential to build reliable extraction rules and to know what documents must exist for any MF bill.

source_name: MF ČR — archiv veřejných konzultací (veřejné diskuze)
why_relevant: Historic archive of numbered MF public consultations (e.g. 'Veřejná konzultace č. V/2012' on the payments act) — useful for reconstructing how MF consults, typical lead times, and which stakeholders respond.

source_name: ČBA — Komise a pracovní skupiny (commissions & working groups)
why_relevant: Maps the internal expert commissions/sub-commissions/working groups staffed by member banks (legislation, payments, AML, etc.). This is the actor map of who drafts ČBA positions — high-value pointer for identifying named experts, topic ownership and where a given consultation response originates.

source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) – activities and seminars
why_relevant: Association body behind CARDFORUM; its activity/working-group pages point to card-security seminars and recommendations (e.g. internet payment security, payment account access), which precede or interpret supervisory expectations.

source_name: ČLFA — Členské společnosti (member directory)
why_relevant: Directory of the ~35 member firms; combined with the stated market-share figures it defines the non-bank regulated population addressed by consumer-credit/leasing regulation. Feeds entity resolution for other workstreams.

source_name: apiportal.cz – CZ bank API aggregator (unverified)
why_relevant: Referenced by the cz-banking-psd2 repo as the more current index of CZ bank APIs (a CzechCrunch piece cites ~28 connectable banks via such a portal). Potentially the best-maintained aggregator for this cell, but not confirmed in this run.

source_name: JirkaChadima/cz-banking-psd2 – list of Czech banks and their developer portals
why_relevant: Community-maintained index mapping ~21 CZ banks to their PSD2 developer-portal URLs. Highest-yield snowball asset for this cell; self-describes updates as sporadic, so treat as a seed, not a live registry.

source_name: konferenceseminare.cz – CZ conference/seminar aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator that indexes CZ finance/banking conferences including Trendy v platebním styku. Best single discovery surface for new, previously unknown regulatory events and organisers.

source_name: Česká fintech asociace (Czech Fintech Association)
why_relevant: Industry body whose positions and press statements are the raw material for the critical media coverage in this cell; a pointer to member firms, spokespeople and consultation responses on Czech/EU payment regulation.

source_name: EduCity.cz – CZ course & conference aggregator (finance/banking)
why_relevant: Second aggregator with historical archive of past conference editions, useful for reconstructing multi-year agenda trend lines (which regulatory topic appeared in which year).

source_name: FAÚ legacy archive site (archiv.financnianalytickyurad.cz)
why_relevant: Archived pre-migration FAÚ content (elektronická komunikace, older OPO pages, superseded guidance). Essential for reconstructing the historical obligation timeline when current pages have been silently rewritten.

source_name: FinTree — FinTech Mapa (Czech fintech market map)
why_relevant: Annual mapping of Czech fintech players; used to build the actor list whose licensing and supervision the media in this cell report on. Pointer only — no regulatory content itself.

source_name: paytech.events – CardForum listing (international event aggregator)
why_relevant: English-language aggregator carrying dates, venue, pricing and agenda pointers for CZ payment events (CardForum Seč, 25–27 May 2026). Useful as an English discovery surface and for structured event metadata.

entity_name: Přehled dozorových orgánů na úseku ochrany spotřebitele
source_name: Přehled dozorových orgánů na úseku ochrany spotřebitele (SOS – Asociace supervisor map)
why_relevant: NGO-maintained map of which Czech authority supervises which consumer-protection area; efficient snowball source for enumerating adjacent conduct regulators beyond ČNB.
